annotations.title: Summarize what a Forge Orbital record attests

description: Verifies a Forge Orbital demo decision record against the pinned demo key and summarizes what it attests: signature status, the decision, whether the engine abstained, whether human review is required, and how many evidence items were used. Does not store the record. Demo records only.

record.description: The complete signed record object returned inside run_check, unchanged, including its signature and original decision fields. Pass the record object, not the outer tool response, a record ID, a summary or a JSON string. Deliberate edits are useful only when demonstrating failed verification.
